description: Àlex Pardo Fernandez and David Sánchez Pinsach published Eixample-MAS to simulate traffic in Barcelona Eixample. Reactive car agents attempt to avoid collisions, while a centralised system coordinates traffic lights. Signals use the number of cars in their streets when requesting permission to change state. Coverage is the Eixample traffic setting; the source does not establish a measured demand period, fixed spatial resolution or validation against observed traffic. The Java model uses Repast and supports agent-based exploration of signal control and vehicle arrival times. Distributed artificial intelligence is listed as unfinished work, so it is not described as a current model feature. Release 1.0.0 is available free through the CoMSES code repository and lists Repast. The release licence is GPL-3.0. Source code and model data were not downloaded or executed. Related resources include the CoMSES computational model library.
